blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Foundation models have shown significant potential across diverse fields and have been applied to medical imaging, but their robustness across patient populations remains unclear. In this work, we investigate foundation models' ability to generalize from adult to pediatric chest X-ray classification. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first benchmark to compare multiple foundation models under a common adult-to-pediatric evaluation setting while also analyzing the effect of adaptation depth. We harmonize VinDr-CXR and PediCXR into a five-label classification task and evaluate six foundation models and two CNN baselines. All models are adapted using adult data only and tested in both the in-domain and pediatric domains using linear probing, partial fine-tuning, and full fine-tuning. The benchmark reveals a clear and consistent trend: all models suffer a substantial performance degradation when transferred from adult to pediatric data, with drops exceeding 10 percentage points. While Macro-AUROC values reach approximately 92% on the adult test set, performance decreases to around 78% on the pediatric domain. Another important finding is that increasing the depth of adaptation does not significantly improve cross-population generalization. Moreover, strong in-domain performance does not translate into better performance on pediatric data.
blocks.zh: 基础模型在各个领域都显示出了巨大潜力,并已应用于医疗成像,但其在病人群体中的稳健性仍不明确。 在这项工作中,我们调查了基础模型从成人到儿科胸X光分级的概括能力. 据我们所知,这是第一个在成人对儿科的共同评价环境中比较多个基础模型的基准,同时也分析了适应深度的影响。 我们把VinDr-CXR和PediCXR统一为五标签分类任务,并评价了六个基础模型和两个CNN基线. 所有模型都仅使用成人数据进行改造,并在内域和儿科领域都使用线性检测,部分微调,并进行全微调试. 该基准显示出一个明确而一致的趋势:所有模型在从成人数据转移到儿科数据时,其性能都大幅下降,下降幅度超过10个百分点。 虽然Macro-AUROC值在成人测试中达到了约92%,但在儿科领域,性能却下降到了约78%. 另一项重要结论是,提高适应深度不会显著地改善跨人口一般化。 此外,强大的域内性能并不能转化为儿科数据的更好性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Illustration of the domain shift between adult and pediatric chest X-rays. The model is trained on the adult source domain and evaluated on the pediatric target domain.
blocks.zh: 图1:成人与儿科胸X光之间域位转移图解. 该模型接受成人源域培训,并在儿科目标域上进行评估.

blocks.en: Medical imaging plays an important role in clinical diagnosis, and deep learning has shown considerable potential for automated medical image analysis. Chest radiography (CXR) is widely used in pediatric care due to its low cost, availability, and relatively low radiation exposure [ 18 ] . However, the development of deep learning systems for chest X-ray analysis has been largely supported by adult datasets. Previous studies have shown that models trained on adult chest radiographs can experience substantial performance degradation when evaluated on pediatric populations [ 5 , 6 , 36 ] . As illustrated in Fig. 1, this problem is closely related to domain shift [ 13 ] , where the data distribution at test time differs from that observed during training. In medical imaging, such differences may arise from acquisition devices, imaging protocols, clinical institutions, annotation practices, or patient populations [ 8 ] . Age is a particularly relevant factor in population shifts in chest radiography, as adult and pediatric examinations differ in anatomical characteristics, disease prevalence, and the presentation of several radiographic findings. Foundation models [ 3 ] have recently emerged as a promising approach for learning transferable representations from large-scale datasets. In medical imaging, these models are commonly pretrained using self-supervised, weakly supervised, or multimodal objectives and can then be adapted to downstream clinical tasks [ 28 ] . Several foundation models have also been developed specifically for medical imaging and chest radiography [ 35 , 1 , 20 ] . Their transfer capabilities make them particularly relevant for studying whether large-scale pretraining can improve robustness across patient populations. Despite this progress, the behavior of foundation models under an adult-to-pediatric CXR domain shift remains poorly characterized. Existing work has mainly focused on individual models, specific tasks, or single adaptation settings. In particular, it remains unclear how foundation models with different pretraining domains and learning objectives compare when evaluated under the same adult-to-pediatric protocol, and how the level of downstream adaptation affects their cross-domain performance. In this work, we study adult-to-pediatric generalization in chest X-ray classification by conducting a standardized comparison between conventional CNNs and foundation models. We evaluate two CNN baselines and six foundation models spanning different pretraining domains and learning objectives. All models are adapted exclusively using adult VinDr-CXR [ 16 ] data and evaluated both in-domain on adult radiographs and cross-domain on PediCXR [ 21 ] , without using pediatric data during downstream adaptation. We evaluate each model under three adaptation strategies: linear probing, partial fine-tuning, and full fine-tuning. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first systematic benchmark of multiple foundation models under a common adult-to-pediatric CXR evaluation protocol. Our main contributions are: • We provide a standardized benchmark of conventional CNNs and foundation models under an adult-to-pediatric chest X-ray domain shift. • We evaluate three downstream adaptation strategies: linear probing, partial fine-tuning, and full fine-tuning, and study how they affect in-domain and cross-domain performance. • We analyze how model family, pretraining domain, and learning objective relate to the performance degradation observed between adult and pediatric populations.
blocks.zh: 医学成像在临床诊断中起着重要作用,深入的学习显示出自动化医学成像分析的巨大潜力. 胸射线学(CXR)由于成本低,可用性低,辐射照射相对较低[18],因此广泛用于儿科护理. 然而,胸X射线分析的深层学习系统的开发,在很大程度上得到了成人数据集的支持. 以往的研究表明,接受过成人胸腔放射图培训的模型在对儿科人群进行评估时,可发生显著性能退化[5、6、36]。 如图1所示,这个问题与域转移[13]密切相关,在测试时的数据分布与培训期间观察到的数据分布不同。 在医学成像中,这种差异可能源于获取装置,成像规程,临床机构,注解做法,或患者群体[8]. 由于成人和儿科检查在解剖特征、疾病流行程度和介绍若干辐射调查结果方面各不相同,因此年龄是胸部射线学中人口变化的一个特别相关因素。 基础模型[3]最近成为从大型数据集学习可转移表述的一种很有希望的方法。 在医学成像中,这些模型通常使用自我监督,弱监督,或多模式目标进行预先训练,然后可以适应下游的临床任务[28]. 还专门为医学成像和胸腔射线摄影开发了几个基础模型[35, 1, 20]. 它们的转移能力使它们特别有助于研究大规模预训能否提高患者的稳健性。 尽管取得了这一进展,在成人到儿科的CXR域位变化中,基础模型的行为特征仍然不佳. 现有工作主要侧重于单个模型、具体任务或单一适应环境。 特别是,尚不清楚不同培训前领域和学习目标的基础模型在根据同一成人至儿科协议进行评价时如何比较,下游适应水平如何影响其跨领域业绩。 在这项工作中,我们通过对常规CNN和基础模型进行标准化比较,研究胸部X射线分类中的成人对儿科的概括化. 我们评价两个有线电视新闻网基线和六个基础模型,涉及不同的培训前领域和学习目标。 所有模型都专门使用成人VinDr-CXR[16]数据进行改造,并在成人射电图上和PediCXR[21]上进行域内评价,在下游改造时不使用儿科数据. 我们根据三个适应战略评估每个模型:线性探测、部分微调和完全微调。 据我们所知,这是在普通成人对儿科CXR评价协议下,第一个系统化的多个基础模型基准. • 我们的主要贡献是: 在成人至儿科胸X射线域转换下,我们提供常规CNN和基础模型的标准基准。 我们评价三种下游适应战略:线性探测、部分微调和全面微调,并研究它们如何影响域内和跨域的业绩。 我们分析模式家庭、培训前领域和学习目标如何与观察到的成人和儿科人口之间的性能退化相联系。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Foundation Models for Medical Imaging
blocks.zh: 2.1 医疗成像基础模型

blocks.en: Foundation models have become increasingly adopted in medical imaging, offering an alternative to task-specific supervised representation learning. Early work in this area focused on vision-language pretraining, following the success of models such as CLIP [ 22 ] in learning transferable representations from large collections of image–text pairs. This idea translated to medical data, where images are often accompanied by free-text reports, and showed that radiology reports can provide useful semantic supervision and support transfer to downstream imaging tasks without relying on extensive manual annotation. More recent methods have explored stronger forms of domain specialization. MedCLIP [ 29 ] adapts contrastive vision-language learning to medical data while reducing the dependence on strictly paired image–text samples, whereas BioMedCLIP [ 35 ] expands the scale of biomedical pretraining using millions of image–text pairs drawn from the scientific literature. At the same time, image-only foundation models have shown that textual supervision is not a prerequisite for transferable visual representations. DINOv2 [ 17 ] , despite being trained on general-domain images, achieves strong transfer across visual tasks through self-supervised learning. These models therefore provide a useful basis for studying how architecture, pretraining modality, and domain specificity affect transfer to medical imaging tasks.
blocks.zh: 基础模型在医学成像学中日益被采用,为特定任务监督的代表学习提供了一种替代办法。 这个领域的早期工作侧重于视觉语言的预训,此前,CLIP[22]等模式在学习大量图像-文本对集的可转移表述方面取得成功。 这个想法被翻译为医学数据,其中图像往往伴随着自由文字报告,并表明放射学报告可以提供有用的语义监督和支持转移到下游成像任务,而无需依赖广泛的人工注释. 较新的方法探索了更强有力的领域专业化形式. MeDCLIP [29] 将对比性视觉语言学习与医学数据相适应,同时减少对严格配对的图像-文本样本的依赖,而BioMedCLIP [35] 则利用从科学文献中提取的数百万图像-文本对来扩大生物医学预训的规模. 同时,仅以图像为主的基础模型已经表明,文字监督并不是可转移视觉表现的先决条件. DINOv2 [17] 尽管接受过一般领域图像的培训,但通过自我监督的学习,实现了跨越视觉任务的强大转移. 因此,这些模型为研究架构、培训前模式和领域特异性如何影响向医疗成像任务的转移提供了一个有用的基础。

blocks.en: 2.2 Foundation Models for Chest X-rays
blocks.zh: 2.2 胸X光学基础模型

blocks.en: Chest radiography has become an important application area for foundation models because several large datasets provide radiographs together with their corresponding reports. This has made vision-language pretraining particularly attractive. BioViL [ 2 ] , for instance, learns radiology-specific representations from paired chest X-rays and reports, and BioViL-T [ 1 ] extends this idea to longitudinal studies by incorporating temporal information. CheXzero [ 27 ] and CXR-CLIP [ 34 ] also rely on image–text contrastive learning, with a focus on zero-shot and transferable recognition. ELIXR [ 31 ] takes a somewhat different direction, linking chest radiograph representations with large language models. Image-only pretraining has also received increasing attention in chest radiography. RAD-DINO [ 20 ] applies self-supervised DINO-style training to large chest X-ray collections, allowing visual representations to be learned without using the associated reports. More recent models such as RayDINO [ 14 ] and EVA-X [ 33 ] follow a similar direction, further exploring large-scale self-supervised learning for radiographic images.
blocks.zh: 胸射线学已经成为基础模型的一个重要应用领域,因为几个大型数据集连同其相应的报告一起提供放射图. 这使得视觉语言的预训特别具有吸引力。 例如,BioViL[2]从对齐的胸部X光和报告中学习放射学的特异性表现,BioViL-T[1]通过纳入时间信息将这一想法延伸至纵向研究。 Chexzero [27] 和 CXR-CLIP [34] 也依赖于图像-文本对比性学习,重点是零镜头和可转移的识别. ELIXR [31] 方向有些不同,将胸腔射线图表示与大语言模型联系起来. 在胸腔射线学方面,只进行图像预训也越来越受到关注. RAD-DINO [20] 对大胸X射线集进行自我监督的DINO式训练,可以不用相关报告学习视觉表现. RayDINO[14]和EVA-X[33]等较近期的模型也遵循了类似的方向,进一步探索了辐射图像的大规模自我监督学习.

blocks.en: 2.3 Domain Shift in Medical Imaging
blocks.zh: 2.3 医疗成像的域移

blocks.en: In many deep learning settings, it is implicitly assumed that the training and test data follow the same distribution, or at least a very similar one. Medical images are produced in complex clinical environments, and their appearance is affected by several factors [ 8 ] . Differences in scanners, acquisition protocols, institutions, patient populations, and data collection periods can lead to variations between datasets, even when they address the same clinical problem. As a result, a model that performs well on data from one domain may show a considerable drop in performance when evaluated on another domain. Previous studies have reported this effect across different sources of domain shift in medical imaging, including acquisition-related differences, changes between clinical sites, and variations in patient demographics [ 15 ] . Population shift is particularly relevant in this context, since factors such as age, disease prevalence, and other patient characteristics can affect both the appearance of medical images and the distribution of the corresponding findings. This makes cross-population evaluation important when assessing whether a model trained on one patient group can generalize to another.
blocks.zh: 在许多深层学习环境中,隐含地假设培训和测试数据遵循相同的分布,或者至少一个非常相似的数据. 医疗影像是在复杂的临床环境中产生的,其外观受到几个因素的影响[8]. 扫描仪,获取协议,机构,病人群体,以及数据收集时期的差异会导致数据集之间的差异,即使数据集解决了同样的临床问题. 因此,在一个域上的数据上表现良好的模型,在另一个域上评价后,可能显示性能大幅下降. 以往的研究表明,在医学成像的不同域位转移源上,包括获取相关差异,临床地点之间的变化,以及患者人口结构的变化[15] 。 在这方面,人口变化特别相关,因为年龄、疾病流行程度和其他病人特征等因素都可能影响医疗图像的出现和相应结果的分布。 这使得在评估接受过一个病人群体培训的模型是否能够概括到另一个病人群体时,跨人口评价非常重要。

blocks.en: 2.4 Adult-to-Pediatric Domain Shift
blocks.zh: 2.4 成人向儿科领域转移

blocks.en: Age-related domain shift is a relevant issue in chest X-ray analysis, particularly given the limited availability of large pediatric datasets [ 18 ] . Rollan-Martinez-Herrera et al. [ 24 ] reported a clear drop in pneumonia classification performance when a CNN trained on adult data was evaluated in children, with AUC decreasing from 0.95 to 0.82. Tang et al. [ 26 ] explored unsupervised domain adaptation and improved pediatric AUC from 0.893, without adaptation, to 0.963 using unlabeled pediatric images. Similar transfer issues have also been studied in lung segmentation [ 23 , 10 ] , where performance was shown to vary with pediatric age and anatomy. Capellan-Martin et al. [ 4 ] further investigated this problem using self-supervised ViT pretraining for zero-shot pediatric tuberculosis detection. Previous studies have mainly considered task-specific CNNs, individual architectures, or single adaptation settings. Recent work has evaluated foundation models across adult and pediatric CXR populations [ 30 , 7 ] . However, the effect of downstream adaptation depth has not been systematically compared across multiple foundation-model visual encoders under the same adult-to-pediatric transfer protocol. To the best of our knowledge, no systematic comparison of multiple foundation models with different pretraining domains and objectives under the same adult-to-pediatric CXR evaluation setting has been reported.
blocks.zh: 与年龄有关的域位变化是胸X射线分析中的一个相关问题,特别是考虑到大型儿科数据集的提供有限[18]. 罗兰-马丁内斯-赫雷拉等人[24]报告,当接受成人数据培训的CNN在儿童中评价时,肺炎分类表现明显下降,AUC从0.95降至0.82. 唐等编著. [26]探索了无监督域的适应,并改进了儿科AUC,从没有适应的0.893到使用无标签儿科影像的0.963. 在肺部分化[23,10]中也研究了类似的转录问题,其中显示表现随儿科年龄和解剖学而异. 卡佩兰-马丁等人. [4] 进一步通过自我监督的VIT预训来调查这个问题,用于零镜头儿科结核病检测. 之前的研究主要考虑了特定任务CNN,单个架构,或单一的适应设置. 最近的工作评估了成人和儿科CXR人群的基础模型[30,7]. 然而,在同一个成人对儿科转移协议下,多个基础模型视觉编码器之间并没有系统地比较下游适应深度的影响。 就我们所知,没有报告在同一个成人对儿科的CXR评价设置下,将多个基础模型与不同的培训前领域和目标进行系统比较。

blocks.en: 3.2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.2 数据集

blocks.en:
We use two chest X-ray datasets to study the adult-to-pediatric domain shift: VinDr-CXR [ 16 ] for the adult population and PediCXR [ 21 ] for the pediatric population. PediCXR [ 21 ] contains 9,125 pediatric chest X-rays, with 7,728 images in the training set and 1,397 in the test set, annotated with 15 global diagnostic labels. Each image has a multi-label, image-level annotation produced by a single assigned radiologist.
VinDr-CXR [ 16 ] contains 18,000 adult chest X-rays, divided into 15,000 training and 3,000 test images, and provides six image-level labels: Lung Tumor, Pneumonia, Tuberculosis, Other Diseases, COPD, and No Finding. Before constructing the benchmark splits, we performed age-based population screening using the available DICOM metadata. Further details are provided in the Supplementary Material. Since the two datasets use different annotation vocabularies, we harmonize their labels into a common five-label target space consisting of No Finding, Other Diseases, Lung Tumor, Pneumonia, and Tuberculosis. In PediCXR [ 21 ] , Pneumonia, Broncho-pneumonia, and Pleuro-pneumonia are merged into a single Pneumonia label. COPD is excluded from VinDr-CXR [ 16 ] because no corresponding label is available in PediCXR [ 21 ] , while the remaining PediCXR [ 21 ] labels without a counterpart in VinDr-CXR [ 16 ] are not considered as target labels. Table 1 summarizes this mapping. For the VinDr-CXR [ 16 ] training set, each image is independently annotated by three radiologists. Their annotations are aggregated into a single multi-label target vector using an element-wise OR operation, implemented as the maximum across the three binary annotation vectors. Thus, a pathology is considered present if it is reported by at least one radiologist, allowing multiple findings from different annotators to be retained simultaneously. To ensure label consistency, No Finding is set to zero whenever any pathological finding is present. In contrast, no annotator aggregation is required for PediCXR [ 21 ] , since each image has a single annotation. This label harmonization procedure is applied consistently to both the training and test splits of each dataset.
blocks.zh:
我们使用两个胸X射线数据集来研究成人对儿科的域位变化:VinDr-CXR[16]针对成年人口,PediCXR[21]针对儿科人口. PediCXR [21] 包含9,125个儿科胸X射线,在训练集中有7,728个图像,在测试集中有1,397个图像,并附有15个全球诊断标签的注释. 每个图像都有一个多标签,图像级别的注释,由单一的指定放射学家制作.
VinDr-CXR [16] 包含1.8万个成人胸X射线,分为15,000个训练和3,000个测试图像,并提供6个图像级标签:肺肿瘤,肺炎,肺结核,其他疾病,COPD,和无发现. 在划分基准之前,我们利用现有的DICOM元数据进行了基于年龄的人口筛选。 进一步详情见补充材料。 由于两个数据集使用不同的注解词汇表,我们把它们的标签统一为一个共同的五标签目标空间,由无发现,其他疾病,肺肿瘤,肺炎,肺结核组成. 在PediCXR [21]中,肺炎,布朗乔-肺炎,以及Pleuro-肺炎被合并为一个单一的肺炎标签. COPD被排除在VinDr-CXR[16]之外,因为PediCXR[21]没有相应的标签,而VinDr-CXR[16]中未对应的其余PediCXR[21]标签则不被视为目标标签. 表1总结了这次测绘。 对于VinDr-CXR[16]训练集,每个图像由三位放射学家独立注释. 它们的注释被组合成一个单一的多标签目标矢量,使用元素任意的OR操作,作为三个二进制注释矢量的最大执行. 因此,如果至少有一名放射学家报告病理学,则认为病理学存在,从而可以同时保留不同注释者的多种发现。 为确保标签的一致性,在出现任何病理发现时,不将查找设置为零。 相比之下,PediCXR[21]不需要注释器汇总,因为每个图像都有一个单独的注释. 统一标签程序一致适用于每个数据集的培训和测试分解。

blocks.en: 3.3 Models
blocks.zh: 3.3 模式

blocks.en: We select a diverse set of models to investigate how different pretraining strategies and domains relate to robustness under the adult-to-pediatric chest X-ray domain shift. Our benchmark spans two main dimensions: the learning paradigm used during pretraining, ranging from supervised learning to image-only self-supervision and image-text contrastive learning, and the domain of the pretraining data, ranging from natural images to biomedical and radiological data. We first consider DenseNet-121 [ 9 ] and EfficientNet-B0 [ 25 ] as conventional CNN baselines. Both models are initialized with weights obtained through supervised pretraining on natural images and provide a reference for architectures that do not rely on large-scale foundation-model pretraining. We then include DINOv2 [ 17 ] and CLIP [ 22 ] as general-purpose foundation models pretrained on natural-image data. DINOv2 [ 17 ] relies on image-only self-supervised learning, whereas CLIP [ 22 ] uses image-text contrastive pretraining, representing two widely adopted foundation-model pretraining paradigms. To extend the comparison toward domain-specific pretraining, we include BiomedCLIP [ 35 ] , which is pretrained on biomedical image-text pairs. Finally, we consider models whose pretraining is more closely aligned with radiological data: RAD-DINO [ 20 ] , based on image-only self-supervised learning, and BioViL-T [ 1 ] and MedCLIP [ 29 ] , which use image-text pretraining. For all models, we use only the visual encoder and attach the same downstream classification framework. For multimodal models, we do not use the text encoder during downstream training or inference. This common setup ensures that the comparison focuses on the visual representations acquired during pretraining rather than on differences in downstream classification strategies. In this way, these models provide representative points across different pretraining paradigms and levels of domain specificity. Rather than isolating either factor independently, our benchmark lets us assess whether models pretrained with different learning objectives and increasingly domain-relevant data show different levels of robustness when transferring from adult to pediatric chest X-rays.
blocks.zh: 我们选择了一套不同的模式,以调查不同培训前战略和领域在成人-儿科胸X射线域转移下如何与稳健性相关。 我们的基准涉及两个主要层面:在预训期间使用的学习范式,从监督学习到只进行图像自我监督学习和图像文本对比学习,以及预训数据领域,从自然图像到生物医学和放射数据。 我们首先将DenseNet-121[9]和高效Net-B0[25]视为CNN常规基线. 两种模型都以通过对自然图像的有监督的预训获得的权重初始化,并为不依赖大规模基础模型预训的建筑提供参考. 然后,我们把DINOv2[17]和CLIP[22]作为预先在自然图像数据上培训的通用基础模型。 DINOv2 [17] 依赖只由图像自行监督的学习,而CLIP [22] 则使用图像文本对比性预训,代表两个被广泛采纳的基础模型预训范式. 为了将比较扩展到特定域的预训,我们包括BiomedCLIP[35],它预先在生物医学图像文本上训练. 最后,我们考虑其预训与辐射数据更紧密结合的模型:基于仅图像自我监督的学习的RAD-DINO [20],以及使用图像文本预训的BioViL-T [1]和MedCLIP [29]. 对所有模型,我们只使用视觉编码器,并附加同样的下游分类框架. 对于多式联运模式,我们在下游培训或推论期间不使用文本编码器。 这种共同的设置确保了比较侧重于预训期间获得的视觉表现,而不是下游分类策略的差异. 通过这种方式,这些模型提供了不同培训前范式和域特异性水平的代表性点. 我们的基准不是将两个因素分开,而是让我们评估预先训练的模型是否具有不同的学习目标,而且与领域有关的数据越来越多,在从成人胸X光转移到儿科X光时是否显示出不同程度的坚固性。

blocks.en: 3.4 Adaptation Protocols
blocks.zh: 3.4 适应议定书

blocks.en: To evaluate how different levels of model adaptation affect performance under the adult-to-pediatric domain shift, we consider three adaptation protocols: linear probing (LP), partial fine-tuning (PFT), and full fine-tuning (FFT). These protocols progressively increase the number of trainable parameters, ranging from adapting only the classification head to updating the entire visual encoder, allowing us to assess how much modification of the pretrained representations is required for the downstream task [ 12 , 11 ] . In linear probing, the visual encoder is kept frozen, and only the classification head is optimized. This setting evaluates the transferability of the pretrained visual representations without modifying the encoder. In partial fine-tuning, the final encoder block or stage, together with the classification head, is optimized, while the remaining encoder parameters are kept frozen. This provides an intermediate level of adaptation in which high-level representations can adjust to the downstream task while preserving most of the pretrained representation. PFT is defined structurally by unfreezing the final encoder block or stage and is therefore not parameter-matched across architectures. Finally, in full fine-tuning, the entire visual encoder and classification head are jointly optimized, providing the highest degree of adaptation to the training data. Table 2 reports the total number of parameters for each model, together with the number of trainable parameters under LP and PFT. Under FFT, all model parameters are trainable by definition.
blocks.zh: 为了评价不同水平的模型适应如何影响成人到儿科域位变化下的性能,我们考虑了三个适应协议:线性测试(LP),部分微调(PFT)和完全微调(FFT). 这些协议逐渐增加了可训练参数的数量,从只调整分类头到更新整个视觉编码器,使我们能够评估下游任务[12,11]对预先训练的表示值需要进行多少修改. 在线性探测中,视觉编码器保持冷冻,只有分类头被优化. 此设置可以评价预先训练的视觉表现的可转移性,而不修改编码器. 在部分微调中,最后的编码器块或级与分类头一起优化,而其余的编码器参数则保持冻结. 这提供了一种中间的适应水平,高级别代表可以适应下游的任务,同时保留大多数经过培训的代表。 PFT在结构上通过解冻最终编码器块或阶段来定义,因此没有跨架构的参数匹配. 最后,在全面微调中,整个视觉编码器和分类头被联合优化,为培训数据提供了最高程度的适应. 表2报告每个模型的参数总数,以及LP和PFT下的可训练参数数目。 在FFT下,所有模型参数按定义都是可训练的.

blocks.en: Table 2 : Model configurations across adaptation strategies. Model architectures, total parameter counts, and trainable parameters under linear probing (LP) and partial fine-tuning (PFT). Under full fine-tuning, all model parameters are updated.
blocks.zh: 表2:各种适应战略的模型配置。 模型架构,总参数计数,以及线性探测(LP)和部分微调(PFT)下的可训练参数. 在全面微调下,对所有模型参数进行更新.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4. 评价

blocks.en: 4.1 In-Domain & Cross-Domain
blocks.zh: 4.1 内域和跨域

blocks.en: We evaluate all models under two settings: in-domain and cross-domain evaluation. For each adaptation protocol, models are trained exclusively on the VinDr-CXR [ 16 ] adult training set. In-domain performance is measured on the held-out VinDr-CXR [ 16 ] test set, which follows the same source domain as the training data. Cross-domain performance is evaluated on PediCXR [ 21 ] , without any additional training or adaptation using pediatric data. This evaluation protocol allows us to assess not only the predictive performance of each model on the source domain, but also how well it generalizes when transferred to a pediatric population. We compare the in-domain and cross-domain results to quantify the performance degradation associated with the adult-to-pediatric domain shift. The same evaluation procedure is applied to all CNN baselines and foundation models across the three adaptation strategies.
blocks.zh: 我们在两种环境下评价所有模式:内域评价和跨域评价。 每种适应协议的模型都只接受VinDr-CXR[16]成人培训。 域内性能在被搁置的VinDr-CXR [16]测试集中进行测量,该测试集跟训练数据遵循相同的源域. 跨域性能在PediCXR[21]上评价,没有使用儿科数据进行任何额外的培训或改造. 这个评估协议使我们能够不仅评估每个模型在源域的预测性表现,而且评估当转移到儿科人群时,它是如何概括的。 我们比较了域内和跨域结果,以量化与成人到儿科域转移相关的性能退化. 同样的评价程序适用于有线电视新闻网在三个适应战略中的所有基线和基础模型。

blocks.en: 4.2 Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 计量

blocks.en: 4.3 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 4.3 详细执行情况

blocks.en: All experiments were implemented in PyTorch [ 19 ] and conducted on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition GPU. All input images were resized to 224 × 224 pixels, while retaining the model-specific normalization used by each pretrained encoder. No additional data augmentation was applied during training. Models were trained under the three adaptation protocols described above: linear probing, partial fine-tuning, and full fine-tuning. Following [ 32 ] , the classification head was optimized with a learning rate of 10 − 3 10^{-3} in all experiments. For protocols in which the encoder was updated, a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} was used for CNN-based backbones and 10 − 5 10^{-5} for Vision Transformer-based backbones. AdamW was used as the optimizer with a weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} . A learning-rate scheduler was applied to all trainable parameter groups, multiplying the learning rate by 0.7 0.7 every 15 epochs. After age-based screening, a fixed 80/20 split resulted in 11,894 training and 2,974 validation images. Supplementary Tables report detailed split statistics. This split was generated once and kept fixed across all models and adaptation protocols to ensure a consistent comparison. The official VinDr-CXR test set was kept separate and used only for in-domain evaluation. All models were trained for 100 epochs with a batch size of 32. Model selection was performed on the source-domain validation set, with the checkpoint achieving the highest macro-averaged AUROC retained for evaluation. Binary cross-entropy with logits was used as the training objective. To account for class imbalance, class-specific positive weights were computed from the adult training set as the ratio of negative to positive samples for each class and incorporated into the loss. Each experiment was repeated using three different random seeds, and results are reported across the three runs.
blocks.zh: 所有实验均在PyTorch [19] 进行,并在NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q工作站版GPU上进行. 所有输入图像的大小都调整为224×224像素,同时保留了每个预训编码器使用的模型特定正常化. 培训期间没有增加数据。 在上述三项适应议定书下培训了模型:线性探测、部分微调和完全微调。 之后[32],分类头被优化,在所有实验中学习率为10−3 10−3}. 对于更新编码器的协议,基于CNN的骨干采用了10−4 10^{-4}的学习率,而基于Vision Transformer的骨干采用了10−5 10^{-5}. AdamW被用作最优化器,重量衰减为10−4 10−4}. 对所有可训练参数组都采用了学习率计时器,将学习率乘以每15个纪元0.7. 经过基于年龄的筛选,固定的80/20分数产生了11,894次培训和2,974次验证图像. 补充表格报告详细分列的统计数据。 这种分割是一次性产生的,并固定在所有模型和适应协议中,以确保一致的比较。 官方VinDr-CXR测试集被单独保存,仅用于域内评价. 所有型号都为100个世纪训练,批量规模为32. 在源域验证集上进行了模型选择,检查点实现了最大宏观平均的AUROC保留以供评价. 二进制与对数的交叉输入被用作培训目标。 为了考虑到班级不平衡,从成人培训中计算出具体班级的正权重,作为每个班级的负与正的样本比例,并计入损失。 每次实验都使用三种不同的随机种子重复进行,结果报告在三次运行中.

blocks.en: We include two conventional CNN architectures as baselines to provide a reference for comparison with the evaluated foundation models. DenseNet-121 [ 9 ] uses dense connections between layers, which encourage feature reuse and improve information and gradient propagation throughout the network. EfficientNet [ 25 ] follows a compound scaling strategy that jointly balances network depth, width, and input resolution, providing a computationally efficient convolutional architecture. These models allow us to assess whether foundation models provide an advantage over established CNN-based approaches under the same training and evaluation settings.
blocks.zh: 我们把两个传统的有线电视新闻网架构作为基线,为与评价的基础模型进行比较提供参考。 DenseNet-121 [9] 采用层间密集连接,鼓励特性再利用,改进信息,改进整个网络的梯度传播。 效率网[25]遵循复合缩放策略,联合平衡网络深度,宽度,输入分辨率,提供计算效率的演化架构. 这些模型使我们能够评估基础模型在相同的培训和评价环境中是否比基于CNN的既定方法提供了优势。

blocks.en: 5 Results
blocks.zh: 5 结果

blocks.en: We structure our analysis around four research questions. RQ1 asks which models transfer most effectively from adult to pediatric data. RQ2 examines how pretraining domain and supervision paradigm relate to robustness under this shift. RQ3 evaluates how linear probing, partial fine-tuning, and full fine-tuning affect pediatric performance and cross-domain robustness. Finally, RQ4 assesses whether in-domain performance reliably reflects cross-domain performance and robustness.
blocks.zh: 我们围绕着四个研究问题进行分析。 RQ1询问哪些模型能最有效地从成人数据转移到儿科数据. RQ2研究了在这种转变下培训前领域和监督模式与稳健性的关系。 RQ3评价线性探测,部分微调,全微调如何影响儿科表现和跨域稳健性. 最后,RQ4评估了域内性能是否可靠地反映了跨域性能和稳健性.

blocks.en: 5.1 Foundation Models vs. CNNs
blocks.zh: 5.1 基金会模型与CNN模型

blocks.en: RQ1 compares the transfer of ImageNet-pretrained CNNs and foundation models from adult to pediatric domains. As shown in Table 3 , all models degrade under the domain shift, but the magnitude of the drop varies considerably. Under linear probing, the strongest foundation models clearly outperform DenseNet-121 [ 9 ] and EfficientNet-B0 [ 25 ] on the pediatric set and exhibit smaller domain-shift gaps. BiomedCLIP [ 35 ] , MedCLIP [ 29 ] , and RAD-DINO [ 20 ] achieve pediatric AUROCs approximately 75% or higher, compared with 56.11% and 46.84% for DenseNet-121 [ 9 ] and EfficientNet-B0 [ 25 ] . This advantage is not universal: DINOv2 [ 17 ] shows a similar gap to the CNN baselines, while BioViL-T [ 1 ] suffers the largest drop under linear probing. The advantage changes with stronger adaptation. In particular, DenseNet-121 [ 9 ] becomes competitive with several foundation models under full fine-tuning, whereas EfficientNet-B0 [ 25 ] remains less robust. Overall, the strongest foundation models transfer better than the ImageNet-pretrained CNNs, especially under limited adaptation, although foundation-model pretraining alone does not guarantee robustness.
blocks.zh: RQ1比较了ImageNet预选的CNN和基础模型从成人领域到儿科领域的转移. 如表3所示,所有模型都会在域位移下降解,但下降的幅度差别很大. 在线性测试下,最强的基础模型在儿科集上明显优于DenseNet-121[9]和高效Net-B0[25],并显示出较小的域间间间距. BiomedCLIP [35],MedCLIP [29],以及RAD-DINO [20] 实现儿科AUROCs约75%或更高,而DenseNet-121 [9]和高效Net-B0 [25]则分别占56.11%和46.84%. 这一优势并不普遍:DINOv2 [17] 显示与CNN基线存在类似差距,而BioViL-T [1] 则在线性探测下遭受最大下降. 优势随着更强的适应而变化. 特别是,DenseNet-121[9]在全面微调下与若干基础模型竞争,而高效率的Net-B0[25]则仍然不够健全。 总体而言,最强基础模型的传输优于ImageNet(英语:ImageNet)预装的CNN,特别是在有限的改编下,虽然仅基础模型预训并不能保证坚固性.

blocks.en: 5.2 Influence of Pretraining on Domain-Shift
blocks.zh: 5.2 预先培训对域-屏蔽的影响

blocks.en: RQ2 compares general-purpose foundation models (CLIP [ 22 ] and DINOv2 [ 17 ] ), medical vision-language models (BiomedCLIP [ 35 ] , MedCLIP [ 29 ] , and BioViL-T [ 1 ] ), and the CXR-specific image-only RAD-DINO [ 20 ] . Clear differences appear across these pretraining settings. RAD-DINO [ 20 ] shows the most consistent transfer, maintaining a pediatric AUROC of approximately 80% across all three adaptation protocols. MedCLIP [ 29 ] and BiomedCLIP [ 35 ] also perform strongly with linear probing, but their pediatric performance decreases as more parameters are fine-tuned. In contrast, BioViL-T [ 1 ] benefits substantially from stronger adaptation, improving from 39.23% with linear probing to 68.16% with full fine-tuning. General-purpose models are similarly sensitive to the adaptation strategy, with DINOv2 [ 17 ] performing best under partial fine-tuning and CLIP [ 22 ] under full fine-tuning. Among the evaluated models, the CXR-specific image-only RAD-DINO [ 20 ] shows the most stable behavior across adaptation protocols, while general-purpose and medical vision-language models exhibit greater variability.
blocks.zh: RQ2比较了通用基础模型(CLIP [22]和DINOv2 [17]),医学视觉语言模型(BiomedCLIP [35],MedCLIP [29],以及BioViL-T [1]),以及CXR特有的图像只RAD-DINO [20]. 在这些预训设置中会出现明显的差异. RAD-DINO [20] 显示了最一致的转移,在所有三个适应议定书中都保持大约80%的儿科AUROC. MeDCLIP [29] 和 BiomedCLIP [35] 也以线性测试表现出很强的性能,但其儿科性能随着更多参数的微调而下降. 相比之下,BioViL-T[1]大大受益于更强的适应,从39.23%的线性测试提高到68.16%的完全微调。 通用模型对适应战略同样敏感,DINov2[17]在部分微调下表现最佳,CLIP[22]在完全微调下表现最佳. 在被评价的模型中,CXR特异性图像专用RAD-DINO[20]显示的是适应协议中最稳定的行为,而通用和医学视觉语言模型则表现出更大的可变性.

blocks.en: 5.3 Adaptation on Domain-shift Robustness
blocks.zh: 5.3 适应域间变强性

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Pediatric AUROC vs. Domain-shift gap. Colors denote models; circles, squares, and triangles denote linear probing, partial fine-tuning, and full fine-tuning, respectively. Lines connect the three protocols for each model. Lower gaps and higher AUROC are better.
blocks.zh: 图3:小儿AUROC与域间轮班差距。 颜色表示模型;圆,方,三角分别表示线性探测,部分微调,完全微调. 线路连接每个模型的三个协议. 差距较小和AUROC更高更好。

blocks.en: RQ3 examines how linear probing, partial fine-tuning, and full fine-tuning affect pediatric performance and robustness to the adult-to-pediatric shift (Fig. 3 ). On average, pediatric AUROC increases from 60.72% with linear probing to 65.84% with partial fine-tuning and 69.00% with full fine-tuning. The corresponding domain-shift gap decreases from 21.65 to 18.39 and 17.21, indicating that most of the reduction is achieved with partial fine-tuning. However, this varies considerably across models. DenseNet-121 [ 9 ] and BioViL-T [ 1 ] benefit from stronger adaptation, whereas DINOv2 performs best with partial fine-tuning. RAD-DINO [ 20 ] remains almost unchanged across the three protocols, maintaining a pediatric AUROC close to 80%. In contrast, MedCLIP [ 29 ] and BiomedCLIP [ 35 ] achieve their best pediatric performance with linear probing and degrade with further fine-tuning. No single adaptation strategy is optimal for all models: additional fine-tuning can improve transfer, have little effect, or reduce cross-domain performance depending on the pretrained representation.
blocks.zh: RQ3研究了线性检测,部分微调,以及全微调如何影响儿科的性能和稳健到成人对儿科的转变(图3). 儿科AUROC平均由60.72%的线性检测提高到65.84%的部分微调,69.0%的全微调. 相应的域间转换差距从21.65降至18.39和17.21,表明大部分的缩小是通过部分微调实现的. 然而,这在各种模式中差别很大。 DenseNet-121 [9]和BioViL-T [1]受益于更强的适应,而DINov2通过部分微调表现最好。 RAD-DINO [20]在三项协议中几乎保持不变,保持了近80%的儿科AUROC. 相比之下,MedCLIP[29]和BiomedCLIP[35]通过线性检测实现了最佳儿科表现,并通过进一步的微调降解. 没有任何单一的适应战略是所有模型的最优化的:额外的微调可以改善转移,作用很小,或者根据预先训练的表示降低跨域性能.

blocks.en: 5.4 In-Domain vs. Cross-Domain Robustness
blocks.zh: 5.4 内域对跨域强健性

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Adult in-domain versus pediatric AUROC across adaptation strategies. The dashed line indicates equal in-domain and cross-domain performance, and the vertical dotted lines show the corresponding domain-shift gap.
blocks.zh: 图4:不同适应战略的成人域内与儿科AUROC。 虚线表示等域内和跨域性能,垂直点线显示相应的域间位移间隙.

blocks.en: RQ4 examines whether in-domain performance reliably indicates robustness under the adult-to-pediatric shift. As shown in Fig. 4 , all configurations lie below the identity line, confirming a systematic drop in pediatric performance. Although stronger in-domain models generally tend to perform better on pediatric data, the size of the domain-shift gap varies substantially. BioViL-T [ 1 ] illustrates this clearly under linear probing, dropping from 80.66% in-domain AUROC to 39.23% on the pediatric set. In contrast, RAD-DINO [ 20 ] and BiomedCLIP [ 35 ] maintain much smaller gaps while also achieving strong pediatric performance. These results show that in-domain performance alone is not sufficient to assess robustness. Models with similar adult performance can behave very differently after transfer to the pediatric domain.
blocks.zh: RQ4检查域内性能是否可靠地表明在成人到儿科的转变下稳健性. 如图4所示,所有配置都位于身份线下方,证实儿科表现系统下降. 虽然较强的域内模型一般在儿科数据上表现较好,但域间间间间距的大小差别很大. BioViL-T [1]在线性检测中清楚地说明了这一点,在儿科中从80.66%的域内AUROC下降到39.23%。 相比之下,RAD-DINO [20] 和BiomedCLIP [35] 保持了更小的缺口,同时也实现了强大的儿科表现. 这些结果表明,仅靠国内业绩不足以评估稳健性。 成人性能相似的模型在转入儿科领域后,其行为会非常不同.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Our results show that foundation models are not uniformly robust to the adult-to-pediatric shift. RAD-DINO [ 20 ] , MedCLIP [ 29 ] , and BiomedCLIP [ 35 ] preserve performance relatively well under limited adaptation, whereas BioViL-T [ 1 ] exhibits the largest domain-shift gap under linear probing. This is notable because BioViL-T [ 1 ] is also pretrained on medical image-text data. As shown in Table 2 , it is the only foundation model in our comparison that does not use a ViT-based visual encoder and instead relies on a ResNet-50 backbone. This architectural difference, together with differences in the pretraining objective and data, may partly contribute to its distinct behavior. However, the present experiments do not isolate these factors, so medical-domain pretraining alone cannot be considered sufficient for robustness across adult and pediatric populations. RAD-DINO [ 20 ] stands out for its stability across adaptation strategies, with pediatric AUROC remaining close to 0.80% under linear probing, partial fine-tuning, and full fine-tuning. RAD-DINO and DINOv2 [ 17 ] provide a particularly informative comparison, as they share the same ViT-B/14 backbone, model size, and adaptation parameter counts. Despite these similarities, DINOv2 shows a substantially larger domain-shift gap under linear probing and benefits more from downstream adaptation. Their different linear-probing behavior is consistent with a benefit from CXR-specific pretraining, although differences in pretraining data and learning objective prevent a causal attribution.
The adaptation experiments also show that more fine-tuning is not always better. Partial fine-tuning captures most of the average reduction in the domain-shift gap observed with full fine-tuning, while the effect of updating additional parameters varies substantially across models. DenseNet-121 [ 9 ] and BioViL-T [ 1 ] benefit from stronger adaptation, whereas RAD-DINO [ 20 ] changes very little across protocols. MedCLIP [ 29 ] and BiomedCLIP [ 35 ] , by contrast, achieve their best pediatric performance with linear probing and degrade as more parameters are updated. The choice of adaptation strategy therefore appears to depend strongly on the pretrained representation. Finally, strong in-domain performance does not necessarily imply robustness to the adult-to-pediatric shift. Adult and pediatric performance follow the same general trend, but similar in-domain scores do not always translate into similar behavior after the domain shift. BioViL-T [ 1 ] is a clear example: despite performing well on the adult test set, its AUROC drops substantially on the pediatric data. This gap shows that in-domain performance alone gives an incomplete view of how well a model transfers across populations. Evaluating models on shifted populations is therefore important when assessing their robustness and transferability.
blocks.zh:
我们的结果表明,基础模型对成人到儿科的转变并不一致。 RAD-DINO [20],MedCLIP [29],和BiomedCLIP [35] 在有限的适应下保持了相对良好的性能,而BioViL-T [1]在线性探测下显示出最大的域间转移缺口. 这值得注意,因为BioViL-T [1] 也预先接受了医学图像文本数据的培训. 如表2所示,它是我们比较中唯一不使用基于ViT的视觉编码器而依赖于ResNet-50主干线的基建模型. 这种建筑差异,加上前期训练目标和数据的差异,可能在一定程度上促成了其独特的行为. 然而,目前的实验并没有将这些因素隔离开来,因此单凭医学领域预训不能被认为足以使成人和儿科人群保持稳健. RAD-DINO[20]因其在适应战略中的稳定性而突出,在线性探测、部分微调和完全微调下,儿科AUROC仍然接近0.8%。 RAD-DINO和DINOv2[17]提供了特别翔实的比较,因为它们具有相同的Vit-B/14主干线,模型大小和适应参数计数. 尽管有这些相似之处,DINOv2显示在线性探测下,域间转移差距要大得多,并且从下游适应中获得更多好处。 他们不同的线性测试行为符合CXR特定预训的好处,尽管预训数据和学习目标的差异阻止了因果归属.
适应实验还表明,更多的微调并不总是更好的. 部分微调能捕捉到经过充分微调后观察到的域-转移缺口平均减少的大部分,而更新额外参数的效果在不同的模型中差别很大。 DenseNet-121 [9]和BioViL-T [1]受益于更强有力的适应,而RAD-DINO [20] 则在协议中变化很小。 MeDCLIP [29] 和 BiomedCLIP [35] 相比之下,随着更多参数的更新,通过线性检测和降解来达到他们最好的儿科表现. 因此,适应战略的选择似乎在很大程度上取决于事先培训过的代表。 最后,强有力的领域内业绩并不一定意味着成人向儿科转变的强劲。 成人和儿科的性能也遵循相同的一般趋势,但类似的域内分数并不总是在域转移后转化为相似的行为. BioViL-T [1]是一个明显的例子:尽管在成人测试中表现良好,但其AUROC在儿科数据上大幅下降。 这一差距表明,单是域内业绩就无法完整地了解模式在人口之间的转移情况。 因此,在评估人口稳健性和可转移性时,评价被转移人口的模型十分重要。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: Although some comparisons are relatively well controlled, most notably RAD-DINO [ 20 ] and DINOv2 [ 17 ] , which share the same backbone, model size, and adaptation budget, the full set of models differs in architecture, pretraining data, scale, supervision, and learning objective. Moreover, PFT is defined at the block/stage level and is therefore not parameter-matched across architectures. The observed differences should thus be interpreted as associations rather than as evidence that any single factor, such as image-only supervision or CXR-specific pretraining, is responsible for improved robustness. In addition, our evaluation considers a single adult-to-pediatric cross-dataset domain shift. Because the adult and pediatric populations are drawn primarily from different datasets, age cannot be isolated from dataset-specific differences such as image acquisition. The same trends may therefore not hold across other hospitals, acquisition devices, pediatric populations, or types of distribution shift. Further evaluation across additional datasets and clinical settings is needed to determine how these findings generalize.
blocks.zh: 虽然有些比较控制得比较良好,最显著的是RAD-DINO [20]和DINov2[17],它们具有相同的骨干、模型大小和适应预算,但整套模型在结构、预训数据、规模、监督和学习目标方面各不相同。 此外,PFT是在区块/阶段级别上定义的,因此在各种架构中并不匹配参数. 因此,所观察到的差异应被解释为关联,而不是证明任何单一因素,如仅图像监督或CXR特定预训,对增强稳健性负有责任。 此外,我们的评价还考虑到成人对儿科的单一跨数据集域转移。 由于成人和儿科人口主要来自不同的数据集,因此年龄不能与诸如图像获取等数据集特有的差异隔离. 因此,其他医院、购置设备、儿科人口或分配类型的转变可能不会出现同样的趋势。 需要进一步评估其他数据集和临床环境,以确定这些结果如何概括。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: This is the first work to compare several foundation models under the same adult-to-pediatric setting while also varying the level of model adaptation. We benchmark six representative foundation models and two conventional CNNs for chest X-ray classification, systematically evaluating linear probing, partial fine-tuning, and full fine-tuning across models with different pretraining domains and supervision paradigms. Across this benchmark, all models are affected by the shift from adult to pediatric data, but the extent of the degradation varies substantially across pretrained representations. RAD-DINO [ 20 ] , MedCLIP [ 29 ] , and BiomedCLIP [ 35 ] retain comparatively strong pediatric performance with limited adaptation, whereas other models are much more sensitive to the shift. More adaptation is not necessarily better: depending on the model, fine-tuning more of the encoder can improve transfer, have little effect, or even reduce pediatric performance. We also observe that models performing well on the adult test set are not always the ones that transfer best to pediatric data. These results suggest that cross-population robustness depends on both the pretrained representation and how it is adapted to the downstream task. This reinforces the need to evaluate foundation models directly across patient populations, rather than using in-domain performance as a proxy for cross-domain robustness.
blocks.zh: 这是第一个比较同一成人对儿科设置下几个基础模型的工作,同时也改变了模型的适应程度. 我们以6个有代表性的基础模型和2个常规的CNN用于胸X射线分类,系统评价线性检测,部分微调,以及不同预训领域和监督范式的模型之间的全面微调. 在整个基准中,所有模型都受到从成人数据向儿科数据的转变的影响,但退化的程度因事先训练有素的表述而大不相同。 RAD-DINO [20],MedCLIP [29],和BiomedCLIP [35] 保持相对强大的儿科性能,适应性有限,而其他模型对转变更为敏感. 更多的适应不一定更好:根据模型,多微调编码器可以改善转录,效果很小,甚至降低儿科性能. 我们还观察到,在成人测试中表现良好的模型并不总是那些将最好的模型转移到儿科数据。 这些结果表明,跨人口的稳健性取决于预先训练的代表权以及如何适应下游的任务。 这就更需要直接在患者群体中评价基础模型,而不是将域内表现作为跨域稳健性的代名词.
